Network Security

Criptografia de Tecido de Rede

Encryption mechanisms applied to the entire data path within a network fabric, ensuring confidentiality and integrity of traffic between distributed nodes. Referenced in NIST SP 800-207 and IETF RFC 7387.

What is Criptografia de Tecido de Rede?

In this glossary, Criptografia de Tecido de Rede refers to: Encryption mechanisms applied to the entire data path within a network fabric, ensuring confidentiality and integrity of traffic between distributed nodes. Referenced in NIST SP 800-207 and IETF RFC 7387.
